description.descriptive: We will review what the parties propose on advanced AI. Every rating comes with its sources.

shareDescription.demands: We will compare what the parties propose on advanced AI with {operator}'s demands, with sources.
shareDescription.descriptive: We will review what the parties propose on advanced AI, with sources.

quotes.title: Checked quotes
quotes.body: Every rating shows its sources, and every quote is checked against the original document.

history.title: Changes in the open
history.body: Every rating shows when it was last updated and keeps its history.

corrections.title: Public corrections
corrections.body: If we get something wrong, we fix it and record it in a public log.

errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again later.
errors.forbidden: You aren't allowed to do that.
errors.stale: This has changed since you opened it, or can't be done right now. Reload and try again.
errors.linked: Something this refers to has gone, or something still refers to it.
errors.limit: That limit has been reached. Try again later.
errors.notFound: That isn't there any more. Reload the page.
errors.lastCountryAdmin: This is the site's only country admin. Give someone else that role first.
errors.notMember: Only members of the site can be given a role directly. Anyone else needs an invitation.
errors.signedOut: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.draftExists: There is already a draft of this text. Edit that one, or delete it first.
errors.needsDefaultLanguage: Publishing needs the text in the site's default language.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: Sign in with the email address your invitation was sent to.
signIn.noAccount: Accounts are by invitation only. If you need one, ask your team's coordinator.

challenge.title: Two-step verification
challenge.intro: Enter the 6-digit code your authenticator app shows for this account.
challenge.backupIntro: Enter one of the backup codes you saved when you set up two-step verification. Each one works once.

enrol.title: Set up two-step verification
enrol.intro: Every account needs a second step: a code from an authenticator app on your phone, such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Aegis or 2FAS.
enrol.scanTitle: Add this account to your app
enrol.scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app.
enrol.qrLabel: QR code to add this account to an authenticator app
enrol.manual: If you can't scan it, add the account by hand with this key:
enrol.codeHint: Enter the 6-digit code the app now shows, to check it works.
enrol.backupIntro: If you lose your phone, each of these codes lets you sign in once. Keep them somewhere safe, such as a password manager: they won't be shown again.

setPassword.title: Set your password
setPassword.intro: Choose the password for your account. This link works once, for an hour.
setPassword.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A few unrelated words make a strong one that is easy to remember.
setPassword.done: Sign in with it now. You will then set up two-step verification.
setPassword.missing: This page needs the link you were given. Open that link instead.

home.title: Your sites
home.noTenants: You don't have access to any site yet. Your team's coordinator can give you a role.

errors.invalidCredentials: The email address or password is not right.
errors.invalidCode: That code is not right. Check it and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.locked: Too many wrong codes. Wait a few minutes, then sign in again.
errors.tooManyCodes: Too many wrong codes for this sign-in. Please sign in again.
errors.expired: This sign-in has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.invalidLink: This link no longer works: it works once, for an hour. Ask for a new one.
errors.passwordsDiffer: The two passwords are not the same.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again later.

sites.platformAdmin: As a platform admin, you see every site.

dashboard.platformAdmin: You are a platform admin: you may do here what every role may.
dashboard.notPublic: This site isn't public yet: nothing of it shows on the public site until a platform admin turns it on.
dashboard.membersIntro: Who has access to this site, and with which roles.
dashboard.queuesLater: Your work queues (drafts, reviews, reports) will show here once cells can be edited.
dashboard.settingsIntro: Review settings, how long reports are kept, and the policy texts.
dashboard.electionsIntro: Each election's details, methodology, parties and criteria.

signups.title: Signup list
signups.intro: People waiting to hear when the site is ready. Their addresses are never shown here.
signups.unconfirmed: {count, plural, one {# address waiting to be confirmed} other {# addresses waiting to be confirmed}} (deleted after 7 days)
signups.confirmed: {count, plural, one {# confirmed address} other {# confirmed addresses}}
signups.futureElections: {count, plural, one {# of them also wants} other {# of them also want}} to hear about future elections

members.title: Members
members.intro: Everyone with access to this site and the roles they hold. A role that is removed stops working on the member's next request.
members.manageIntro: To give someone new access, they need an invitation. Invitations aren't available yet.
members.name: Name
members.onlyCountryAdmin: The site's only country admin: give the role to someone else before removing it.
members.confirmBody: Remove the {role} role from {name}? They lose what it allows on their next request.
members.confirmSelf: Remove your own {role} role? You lose what it allows straight away.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This page doesn't exist, or you don't have access to it.

review.title: Review
review.liveEdits: A second person must approve changes to a live election
review.liveEditsHint: When on, whoever proposes a change to a live election (its name, date, methodology, parties or criteria) can't approve it themselves. Every approved change is public either way.
review.platformOnly: Only a platform admin changes this.

retention.title: Reports
retention.label: Days a report is kept before its personal data is removed
retention.hint: A change applies to reports sent from then on: each report's date is set when it arrives.

texts.title: Policy texts
texts.intro: The texts the public site shows about the operator and its policies, written per language. A published version never changes; the next one starts as a copy of it.

texts.copyIntro: This starts as a copy of the published version. Saving it keeps it as a draft until it is published.
texts.firstIntro: Write the first version. Saving it keeps it as a draft until it is published.
texts.bodyHint: In Markdown. The public site shows it formatted.
texts.publishBody: A published version never changes: any later change starts a new version. It needs the text in the site's default language.
texts.deleteBody: The draft's text is lost. Published versions stay.
texts.readOnly: Only country admins and platform admins write these texts.

elections.title: Elections
elections.intro: An election is prepared in private as a draft. Its structure can be changed freely until it goes live; after that, changes go through change requests.
elections.newIntro: A new election is a draft, with a second reviewer required to publish and no freeze window.
elections.name: Name

form.name: Name
form.nameHint: As the public site will show it.
form.slugHint: The election's address on the public site: lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, at most 63 characters. It can't change once the election is live.
form.territoryHint: The subdivision's ISO 3166-2 code after {prefix}, such as AN.
form.territoryNone: A general or European election covers the whole country.
form.dateHint: Election day. It can be left empty until it is set.

constraints.slug: Use only lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, at most 63 characters.
constraints.slugLocale: A slug can't look like a language code, such as es or pt-br.
constraints.slugReserved: That slug is reserved for the public site's own pages.
constraints.slugTaken: Another election already uses that slug.
constraints.territoryNeeded: A regional election needs its territory.
constraints.territoryNotAllowed: A general or European election has no territory.
constraints.territoryFormat: Use one to three letters or digits after the country's code.
constraints.nameNeeded: Write the name in at least one language.

election.liveNotice: This election is live: its structure changes only through change requests, which have a public note.
election.archivedNotice: This election is archived: its structure is read-only. Corrections to published cells can still be made.
election.announced: Announce this election on the site's coming-soon page
election.announcedHint: The coming-soon page then gives its name and date, and nothing else about it. It needs the name in the site's default language, and can't change once the election is live.
election.isAnnounced: Announced on the site's coming-soon page.
election.fourEyes: A second person must review cells before they are published
election.fourEyesHint: When on, nobody who worked on a cell can publish it.
election.fourEyesOffTitle: Let one person publish their own work?
election.fourEyesOffBody: With this off, one person may write a cell and publish it themselves. Each such publication is recorded privately as self-reviewed. Turn it off only if the team can't have a second reviewer.
election.deleteIntro: A draft election can be deleted once its methodology, parties and criteria are gone.
election.deleteBody: The election is deleted for good. Only a draft with nothing left in it can be deleted.
election.deleteLinked: Delete its methodology, parties and criteria first.

methodology.kind: Kind: {kind}. It is the site's, and the same for all its elections.

kindNames.demands: the parties' positions compared with an organisation's demands
kindNames.descriptive: a description of each party's position

methodology.none: This election has no methodology yet.
methodology.ownerHint: The organisation whose demands the parties are compared with: the site's operator or one of its endorsers.
methodology.admissible: Sources that may back a rating
methodology.admissibleHint: Quotes can only come from these kinds of source.
methodology.notMentionedHint: A “not mentioned” rating is backed by having checked documents of these kinds.
methodology.usage: Used by {quotes, plural, one {# quote} other {# quotes}} and {checked, plural, one {# checked document} other {# checked documents}}.
methodology.reviewersIntro: People outside the team, named publicly, who reviewed the methodology.
methodology.consent: This person has agreed to be named publicly as a reviewer
methodology.deleteReviewerBody: {name} is no longer named as a reviewer.
methodology.deleteBody: Its text and settings are lost. It can only be deleted once it has no reviewers.
methodology.removedQuotes: {count, plural, one {# quote cites} other {# quotes cite}} this kind: their cells can't be submitted or published until fixed.
methodology.removedChecked: {count, plural, one {# checked document is} other {# checked documents are}} of this kind: their cells can't be submitted or published until fixed.
methodology.kindsNeeded: Tick at least one kind in each list.

structure.readOnly: Only editors and country admins change this, while the election is a draft.
structure.deleteLinked: Cells or sources still refer to it: they go first.

parties.intro: The parties in this election, in the order the public table lists them.
parties.name: Name
parties.shortNameHint: Where space is short, such as on phones.
parties.slugHint: The party's address on the public site: lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens. It can't change once the election is live.
parties.slugTaken: Another party in this election already uses that slug.
parties.colourHint: Used to recognise the party, never to show a rating.
parties.websiteInvalid: The address must start with https:// or http://.
parties.territoriesHint: Only if it doesn't stand everywhere: ISO 3166-2 codes in the country, such as {country}-AN, separated by commas.
parties.territoriesInvalid: Use ISO 3166-2 codes, such as XX-AN, separated by commas.
parties.deleteBody: The party is deleted from this draft election. Its cells and sources must go first.

programme.title: Programme
programme.intro: Whether the party has published its electoral programme, and when we last checked. The public sees both, live elections included.
programme.neverChecked: Not checked yet: the public sees nothing about it.
programme.needsSource: “Published” needs a source of the party marked as its programme. Add one in its sources first.
programme.readOnly: This election is archived: its programme statuses no longer change.

criteria.intro: The criteria the parties are assessed against, in the order the public table shows them.
criteria.title: Title
criteria.shortTitleHint: It heads the criterion's column in the public table, so it has room for a few words only. Going live needs it in the site's default language.
criteria.slugHint: The criterion's address on the public site: lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens. It can't change once the election is live.
criteria.slugTaken: Another criterion in this election already uses that slug.
criteria.textNeeded: Write the title and the description in at least one language.
criteria.coreHint: Optional: the platform-wide criterion this one matches, for comparisons across countries.
criteria.deleteBody: The criterion is deleted from this draft election. Its cells must go first.

status.goLiveIntro: Going live makes the election, its methodology, parties and criteria public, and every cell without a published rating shows as pending. It can't be undone.

needs.activeTenant: The site is public (a platform admin turns it on)
needs.partyNames: Every party's name and short name in {language}
needs.criteriaTexts: Every criterion's title, short title and description in {language}

warnings.noReviewers: The methodology names no external reviewers.

status.notReady: Going live is offered once nothing above is missing.
status.confirmBody: Its slug, type and territory are fixed from then on, and its structure changes only through change requests, each with a public note. This can't be undone.
status.typeSlug: Type the election's slug, {slug}, to confirm
status.freezeIntro: While the window is on, nothing public about the election changes: no publishing, no approval of change requests and no programme status. Drafting, reviewing and comments go on.
status.frozenUntilHint: Empty: frozen until the window is cleared. Times are your browser's.
status.frozenNow: Frozen since {from, date, medium} {from, time, short} UTC, until {until, date, medium} {until, time, short} UTC: nothing public about this election changes until then.
status.frozenOpenEnded: Frozen since {from, date, medium} {from, time, short} UTC, until the window is cleared: nothing public about this election changes until then.
status.frozenSoon: A freeze window starts {from, date, medium} {from, time, short} UTC.
status.archiveIntro: After the results, the election is archived: it and its structure become read-only. Corrections and withdrawals of published cells, new sources for them and report handling continue. It can't be undone.
status.archiveBody: The election and its structure become read-only for good. Corrections and withdrawals of published cells, new sources for them and report handling continue.
status.archiveFrozen: Clear the freeze window first: an archived election can't change it, and corrections would stay frozen with it.
status.endBeforeStart: The end must be after the start.
status.slugMismatch: That isn't the election's slug. Type it exactly.

platform.title: Platform
platform.intro: What every site shares, for platform admins.

organizations.title: Organizations
organizations.intro: The organizations that run or endorse a site. What you write here is public: it appears on the sites each one serves, the legal notice included.
organizations.caption: Organizations and the sites each serves
organizations.name: Name
organizations.newIntro: An organization can serve several sites. Linking it to a site is done separately.

form.displayNameHint: As the public sees it, in the languages of the sites it serves. At least one.
form.legalNameHint: As registered. The legal notice gives it.
form.registryEntryHint: The register it is entered in, and its number there.
form.contactEmailHint: Shown on its sites as the address to write to.
form.privacyEmailHint: The address for questions about personal data.
form.linkHint: A full address starting with https://.
form.pauseaiHint: Its sites may use PauseAI's restricted brand assets only while it is one, so it can't stop being one while they do.

constraints.email: Enter an email address, such as name@example.org.
constraints.link: Enter a full address starting with https://.
constraints.displayName: Enter its name in at least one language.
constraints.pauseai: A site this organization serves uses PauseAI's restricted brand assets, so it has to stay a PauseAI chapter.

signupConfirm.subject: Confirm you want to hear when {site} is ready

legal.title: Legal notice
legal.intro: This website is run by {operator}, which answers for it.

signup.title: Let me know when it’s ready
signup.future: Also tell me about future elections on this site
signup.consent: By signing up you accept our {privacy}.
signup.how: We’ll send you an email to confirm. We use your address only to tell you when the site is ready, and about future elections here if you tick the box. Unconfirmed addresses are deleted after 7 days; the rest once we’ve told you, unless you asked about future elections.

outcome.accepted: Check your inbox: if the address is right, a link to confirm is on its way.
outcome.invalid: That address doesn’t look right. Check it and try again.
outcome.limit: Too many requests right now. Try again later.
outcome.failed: We couldn’t send the email. Try again later.
outcome.unavailable: Signing up isn’t available right now.

confirm.title: Confirm your signup
confirm.lead: Press the button to confirm that you want to hear when {site} is ready.
confirm.done: Done: we’ll let you know when {site} is ready.
confirm.invalid: This link isn’t valid any more. You can sign up again on the home page.
confirm.missing: This page needs the link from your email.
confirm.undo: Changed your mind? You can unsubscribe with the link in the email.

unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe
unsubscribe.lead: Press the button to delete your address from {site}’s list.
unsubscribe.done: Done: your address has been deleted.
unsubscribe.invalid: This link isn’t valid any more: the address may already be deleted.
unsubscribe.missing: This page needs the link from your email.

question.descriptive: What does each party propose on advanced AI?

election.noRatingsYet: No rating has been published yet: every cell is pending.
election.tableCaption: {election}: each party’s rating on each criterion

cellPage.title: {party} · {criterion}
cellPage.pendingLead: This cell hasn’t been rated yet. Pending is not a rating: it doesn’t mean the party says nothing.
cellPage.withdrawnLead: This rating was withdrawn. Its history says why.

methodologyPage.title: Methodology
methodologyPage.demands: Each rating says how far a party meets the demands of {owner}.
methodologyPage.descriptive: Each rating describes what a party proposes on advanced AI.
methodologyPage.pending: Pending means not rated yet, which is not the same as “not mentioned”.
